national_data_note: A blank row means this repository has not yet verified a source for that holding. It is not a statement that the country holds no such data. Every named holding, operator, legal basis, hosting arrangement and figure is cited to a quote found by machine in a downloaded document; no person has verified them.

checks.name: Researched claims (holdings, operators, legal bases, indicators)
checks.what: the cited page or PDF was downloaded and its SHA-256 recorded, and the quoted text was found in the extracted document by literal matching. Every number and date in the printed value was found in the original-language quote; the English wording is a machine summary of the quote unless it appears in it verbatim. An archived copy was looked up on the Internet Archive; where none exists the footnote says so.

checks.name: Eurostat figures
checks.what: the value was read from a pinned Eurostat dataset through its API and compared with the table cell, within 0.5%. The footnote names the dataset, its dimensions and the retrieval date.

checks.name: Categorical findings (infrastructure dependency, sovereignty indicators)
checks.what: admitted only when a second, independent automated reviewer reached the same value from the same quote.

notice.disclaimer: Machine-checked, not human-verified. Automated agents found these sources and checked them mechanically; no person has reviewed the findings. English wording of a non-English source is a machine translation or a machine summary of the quoted text. Treat each fact as a lead to its cited source, not as established. Corrections are welcome through the repository's issue template.
notice.grade_rule: Strong: a T1 or T2 source (an authoritative original or a competent public body); an official or primary source; the quote found exactly in the hashed document; an archived copy of exactly that URL; no name in the value missing from the quote; and the value either quoted from an English source, found verbatim in the original, or resting on figures matched in the original. A categorical finding is Strong only after a blind review. Standard: every required check passed, but one of those did not. Anything less is not printed.
notice.withheld: A value that no checked source supports is withheld and shown as a gap. A gap means not yet sourced, never that the thing does not exist.

priority_rule: Priority = consequence of loss (tier 0: 3, tier 1: 2, tier 2: 1, tier 3: 0) + difficulty of rebuilding (low recoverability: 2, medium: 1, high: 0) + known exposure to non-EU providers (non-EU or mixed: 2, EU provider or not yet known: 1, national: 0). Critical is 6 or more, High is 4 or 5.

sovereignty.confidence_rule: Confidence is how many groups a state could still reach if every unknown resolved for or against it: one group is High, two Medium, three or more Low. Within a group, states are alphabetical; the order carries no meaning.

groups.label: Sovereign in law and in practice
Sovereign in practice, not secured in law
Secured in law, not yet in practice

sovereignty.guardrail: Groups describe what the sources show, not how sovereign a state is. A Low-confidence placement mostly reflects research that is not finished.

indicators.label: Jurisdiction requirement
indicators.question: Does a statute or binding regulation require government data (or classified government data) to be stored and processed under national or EU jurisdiction?

indicators.label: Classification in law
indicators.question: Is the government's data classification scheme established in a statute or binding regulation?

indicators.label: Sovereign cloud certification
indicators.question: Is a cloud certification that requires immunity from non-EU law in force or adopted for government use?

indicators.label: State-controlled trust anchor
indicators.question: Is the root of the government's public key infrastructure or its qualified trust service operated by the state or a state-controlled body?

indicators.label: State-controlled national eID
indicators.question: Is the national electronic identity scheme operated by the state or a state-controlled body?

indicators.label: Government data centres
indicators.question: Does the state operate its own government data centres that are in operation today?

indicators.label: Government cloud in operation
indicators.question: Is a national sovereign or government cloud platform in operation (not announced)?

rule.condition: a source shows a tier 0 or 1 holding on non-EU infrastructure, or a national eID or trust anchor outside state or EU control
rule.label: Dependent on non-EU providers

rule.condition: a statute keeps government data under national or EU jurisdiction, and at least 75% of verified tier 0/1 holdings run on national or EU infrastructure, the trust anchor and eID are state-controlled, and the state runs its own data centres or government cloud
rule.label: Sovereign in law and in practice

rule.condition: the practice test, without the statute
rule.label: Sovereign in practice, not secured in law

rule.condition: the statute, without the practice test
rule.label: Secured in law, not yet in practice

sovereignty.unknown_rule: An input without a checked source is unknown and counts as not demonstrated: never as sovereign, never as dependent.
